policy: Donor files were read at their pinned commit in the local mirror (tools/mirrors.py), as data; nothing was run. Ideas only, in westack's own words; no donor text is copied (skills/westack/provenance/RIGHTS.md). The component classification is skills/westack/provenance/absorption.json (gstack.deploy).

usefulness_legend.strong: shaped the skill's structure or its numbers
usefulness_legend.useful: added a rule or a check

sources.read: steps 1-4: platform detection from fly.toml, render.yaml, vercel.json, netlify.toml, Procfile, railway files and workflows; per-platform URL and health check
steps 6-7 (lines 241-330): deploy strategies, bounded waits, status failure as unknown, no automatic revert, canary read-back

taken.mechanism: Platform detection from the project's own files, each with the file that says so, and asking when nothing or several match.
A generic reachable URL cannot certify a new deployment: the read-back must show this revision.
Bounded waits of twenty minutes with the user asked before waiting again, and a status query that fails treated as unknown, never success.
A failed deploy is reported and the user chooses: no automatic revert, and rollback monitoring never triggers a second revert.

rejected: Merging the PR as part of deploying: merge and release are westack-ship's, each under its own grant.
Writing a deploy configuration section into CLAUDE.md: the detection runs each time; persisting it would be an instruction-file edit.
gstack's ci-gate, pr-wait and canary binaries: the agent reads CI and the target itself; the helper runs no command.
